scope: Census of all remaining training records in conservative short-prose slice with .edu/.gov/.ac.uk/.gov.uk host; all previous validation sample families reserved. Host is a retrieval scope only, never evidence of semantic correctness.
review_requirement: Read every selected text in full. Admit only pass label, exclude minor/fail/major conservatively. No sample extrapolation.
additional_recovery: Previously reviewed FineWeb pass-without-issue records may be admitted individually, regardless of source-wide rejection; they are tuning/reviewed training material, never heldout validation evidence.
splits: Recovered documents remain in original training split only. FineWeb development/test remain quarantined. TinyStories splits unchanged.
